description: Hara's witness slip reports that she sounded the Reed Bell at the Mother-Tide Gate before the Moon-Basin Vow.
Sen's tally records the return of the first low-water signal before the Moon-Basin Vow.
Hara's slip places the single Moon-Basin Vow of Saltmonth 4 at the Mother-Tide Gate during the first low-water bell.
Sen's register places that same single Moon-Basin Vow of Saltmonth 4 at Ash-Dune Sanctuary during the first low-water bell.
